Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Were the security team at Orion Health and were kicking off our vendor intake for SIG and SOC 2. We received the questionnaire and had a few clarifying questions that are easier to go over live.

Are you or someone from the Redwood compliance team available for a 45-minute call next week (Aug 4-6)? Our preference is afternoons PT.

Attached is our worksheet (Orion_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx) with some Qs flagged in column D. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirmation of data residency options for Private deployments
- Snapshot samples for log retention and admin audit trails
- Clarification on model variant fallback & customer data isolation

If you cant make any of those times, share availability and well accommodate. Also, please confirm whether Redwood records calls for internal notes; we need explicit consent before recordings.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Information Security Analyst
Orion Health Systems

- Tue Aug 4, 2:00-2:45pm PT
- Wed Aug 5, 3:00-3:45pm PT

Attendees from Redwood: myself (Security intake lead), Marissa Cole (Customer Success / evidence owner), David Kim (Platform engineer — logs & retention SME). Please let us know which slot works and whether you need a conference bridge or a Zoom link.

Pre-call asks so we can prioritize:
- The two highest-priority SIG questions (call out by row number in the attached workbook)
- Any specific log sample formats you need (e.g., syslog, structured JSON app logs)

Priority rows: weve marked rows 12, 23, and 47 in the attached for discussion (row numbers on our worksheet). For logs wed like to see a sample of admin audit trails (who changed role/permission), and an example of an access log with a token/session ID (redacted is ok).

Evidence owner on our side: that will be me and Nathan Li (security@orion-health.com). Nathan may join the call.

Ive accepted the tentative invite and attached a short internal scope note. If you need pre-call extracts, ping me and Ill upload to the Drive link.

Subject: [Meeting follow-up] Orion SIG Q&A — notes, action items, and artifact links

Maya / Nathan / security team,

Thanks for a productive call today. Notes and quick action log below (pulled from recording). Were leaving the recording in Redwoods internal folder per consent (not shared outside Redwood).

Meeting summary (45 min):
- Covered rows 12 (data residency options), 23 (admin audit trails), and 47 (model fallback policies).
- Confirmed Redwood Private supports customer VPCs in AWS regions and we documented the list of available regions (see Drive link).
- Demoed a redacted admin-audit sample (who changed role, timestamp, actor) and walked through retention policy (default 365 days for full audit trails; 30 days for ephemeral logs unless pinned).
- Clarified model variant fallback sequence (primary model -> smaller quantized variant -> hosted fallback) and customer data isolation guarantees for Dedicated/Private tiers.

Action items:
1) Redwood (Marissa): Provide a downloadable redacted audit sample in JSON format (admin-audit-redacted-20260805.json) and upload to shared Drive by EOD 2026-08-06.
2) Redwood (David): Export an example token/session access log (redacted) and include field-level mapping; due 2026-08-07.
3) Orion (Maya): Share any additional SIG rows to prioritize beyond the three discussed by 2026-08-06.
4) Both: Confirm any legal constraints around recordings; Orion to provide written confirmation if required by legal counsel.

Attachments / links provided in thread:
- Drive folder (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleEvidenceFolder
- Redwood SOC2 scope: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (attached earlier)

If anything is missing from my notes, please reply-all with corrections. Well upload the artifacts to the Drive folder once ready and flag them in this thread.

Best regards,
